name: Back To The Way I Was
source:
"Back To The Way I Was" is a leisurely, gentle, and vanilla adventure story centered on three main characters. After years of online friendship, they decide to finally meet in person.

But no one expected that the first meeting of these "internet friends" would end in sour faces, misunderstandings, and mutual disappointment. Faced with the stark difference between their online personas and who they are IRL, they find themselves swept into an unplanned journey to a place none of them ever wanted to go.
